name: @observertc/digest-schema
description: The analytics digest contract, version 1: JSON Schema, metric registry, immutable histogram definitions, calculation policies and reason codes. Shared by the stats dashboard and any processor that writes digests.
author: ObserveRTC
comment: `private: true` until this is published. It is a package rather than a loose
folder because it is the one thing the dashboard and the processor share, and
naming it as a dependency is how that stays true — a relative path into a
sibling directory is a coupling nobody declares and everybody forgets.
Until it is published, each consumer gets the artifacts its own way:
the dashboard generates TypeScript and validators from it in-tree
(`npm run schema:generate` at the repo root), and src/digest-server/ keeps a
checksummed copy under vendor/ because a Docker build context cannot reach
outside the directory it is given. Both are verified against this folder, so
Publishing this removes both mechanisms: `npm i @observertc/digest-schema`,
and the vendor folder and the sync script are deleted.
